items.name: Mural-like Layout
items.description: Bold, symbolic composition inspired by Pompeian ruins.
items.prompt_inject: Compose the visual like an ancient mural: use raw textures, earthy tones, and center-focused symbolic placement.

items.name: Papyrus Scroll Narrative
items.description: Story unfolds left-to-right like an ancient scroll.
items.prompt_inject: Structure the narrative as a horizontal scroll: reveal information sequentially left-to-right with aged parchment textures and hieroglyphic borders.

items.name: Renaissance Perspective Grid
items.description: Single vanishing-point composition for depth and focus.
items.prompt_inject: Apply single-point Renaissance perspective: draw the viewer's eye to the product at the vanishing point using converging architectural lines.

items.name: Chiaroscuro Contrast
items.description: Dramatic light-dark interplay à la Caravaggio.
items.prompt_inject: Use Caravaggio-style chiaroscuro: bathe the product in a single dramatic light source against deep shadows to create emotional intensity.

items.name: Heraldic Emblem Design
items.description: Symmetrical crest-style branding for authority.
items.prompt_inject: Design the brand identity as a heraldic crest: use bilateral symmetry, shield motifs, and ribbon banners to convey legacy and authority.

items.name: Gutenberg Print Block
items.description: Typography-first design echoing early movable type.
items.prompt_inject: Emulate Gutenberg press aesthetics: use bold serif typography as the hero element, ink-press textures, and justified text blocks with ornamental drop caps.

items.name: Claude Hopkins' Reason-Why
items.description: Logical, fact-based persuasion strategy.
items.prompt_inject: Apply 'Reason-Why' copywriting: List exactly 3 undeniable logical benefits of this product in a structured, numbered format.

items.name: Baroque Excess
items.description: Ornate, overwhelming detail for luxury products.
items.prompt_inject: Channel Baroque opulence: fill every corner with gilded ornaments, swirling details, and rich fabrics to convey maximum luxury.

items.name: Woodblock Ukiyo-e Flow
items.description: Japanese wave-like visual flow and flat color planes.
items.prompt_inject: Apply Ukiyo-e composition: use flowing wave-like lines, flat bold color planes, and asymmetric balance inspired by Hokusai.

items.name: Classical Mythology Frame
items.description: Product elevated through mythological narrative.
items.prompt_inject: Frame the product within a mythological narrative: position it as an artifact of the gods using classical Greek/Roman visual metaphors and heroic poses.

arsenal_database.phase: Phase 2: The Golden Age of Advertising (1900s-1960s)

items.name: Art Nouveau Organic Flow
items.description: Sinuous, nature-inspired decorative borders.
items.prompt_inject: Apply Art Nouveau styling: use sinuous organic lines, floral motifs, and Mucha-inspired decorative borders framing the product.

items.name: Rosser Reeves' USP Hammer
items.description: One single Unique Selling Proposition repeated relentlessly.
items.prompt_inject: Identify the ONE unique selling proposition and hammer it: repeat the single core benefit in headline, subhead, and visual so it becomes unforgettable.

items.name: Norman Rockwell Storytelling
items.description: Warm, relatable slice-of-life illustration.
items.prompt_inject: Create a Norman Rockwell moment: depict a warm, relatable everyday scene where the product naturally belongs, using hyper-detailed illustration and warm lighting.

items.name: Swiss Grid System
items.description: Mathematically precise layout with Helvetica dominance.
items.prompt_inject: Apply strict Swiss International Style: use a 12-column grid, Helvetica typography, generous white space, and asymmetric balance for maximum clarity.

items.name: David Ogilvy's Long Copy
items.description: Detailed, research-backed persuasive body text.
items.prompt_inject: Write in Ogilvy's long-copy tradition: open with a magnetic headline, follow with detailed benefit-driven paragraphs backed by specific facts and testimonials.

items.name: Propaganda Poster Impact
items.description: Bold colors, strong typography, call-to-action urgency.
items.prompt_inject: Design with propaganda poster intensity: use bold primary colors, oversized sans-serif headlines, pointed finger motifs, and urgent imperative verbs.

items.name: Pin-Up Illustration Style
items.description: Retro glamour illustration with nostalgic charm.
items.prompt_inject: Apply 1950s pin-up illustration aesthetics: use saturated colors, idealized figures, playful poses, and vintage halftone dot patterns.

items.name: Bill Bernbach's Creative Revolution
items.description: Wit-driven, anti-establishment clever advertising.
items.prompt_inject: Channel Bernbach's creative revolution: pair a witty, unexpected visual with a clever headline that subverts expectations. Think VW 'Think Small' energy.

items.name: Bauhaus Functional Design
items.description: Form follows function, geometric purity.
items.prompt_inject: Apply Bauhaus principles: use primary colors, geometric shapes (circle, square, triangle), sans-serif type, and absolute functional minimalism.

items.name: Mid-Century Modern Palette
items.description: Atomic-age optimism with teal, orange, and mustard.
items.prompt_inject: Use a mid-century modern palette: teal, burnt orange, mustard yellow, and olive green with atomic-age starburst motifs and boomerang shapes.

arsenal_database.phase: Phase 3: The Television & Pop Culture Era (1960s-1990s)

items.name: Andy Warhol Pop Art
items.description: Mass-produced repetition with bold color shifts.
items.prompt_inject: Apply Warhol's Pop Art method: repeat the product image in a 2x2 or 3x3 grid with dramatic color shifts (cyan, magenta, yellow, green) on each tile.

items.name: Psychedelic Poster Warp
items.description: Swirling colors, distorted typography, acid-trip visuals.
items.prompt_inject: Create a psychedelic poster: use swirling rainbow gradients, melting/warping typography, paisley patterns, and kaleidoscopic symmetry.

items.name: MTV Quick-Cut Rhythm
items.description: Rapid visual cuts synced to a beat.
items.prompt_inject: Edit with MTV energy: design each scene for maximum 2-second retention, use jump cuts, split screens, and visual rhythm synced to an implied beat.

items.name: Saatchi & Saatchi Shock Value
items.description: Provocative imagery that demands attention.
items.prompt_inject: Deploy Saatchi-level shock: create a single arresting image so provocative and unexpected it stops the viewer mid-scroll and demands a second look.

items.name: VHS Retro Glitch
items.description: Analog video degradation for nostalgic authenticity.
items.prompt_inject: Apply VHS degradation: add scan lines, tracking errors, color bleeding, timestamp overlay (REC ●), and chromatic aberration for analog nostalgia.

items.name: Nike 'Just Do It' Manifesto
items.description: Empowerment-driven brand manifesto copywriting.
items.prompt_inject: Write a brand manifesto: use short, punchy, empowering sentences that build to an emotional crescendo. End with a 2-4 word battle cry tagline.

items.name: Supermarket Tabloid Layout
items.description: Sensational headlines, chaotic yet compelling layout.
items.prompt_inject: Design like a tabloid cover: use screaming headlines in multiple sizes, star-burst sale badges, before/after comparisons, and 'exclusive' stamps.

items.name: Grunge Typography
items.description: Distressed, rebellious type design of the 90s.
items.prompt_inject: Apply 90s grunge typography: use distressed, overlapping, partially obscured type with torn paper textures, xerox artifacts, and anti-design composition.

items.name: Infomercial Urgency Engine
items.description: But-wait-there's-more sequential reveal.
items.prompt_inject: Structure as an infomercial: demonstrate the problem dramatically, reveal the product as savior, stack bonuses, add countdown urgency, and a 'Call Now' CTA.

items.name: Keith Haring Line Energy
items.description: Bold outlines, kinetic figures, democratic art.
items.prompt_inject: Use Keith Haring's visual language: bold black outlines, radiant baby motifs, kinetic dancing figures, and flat primary colors on solid backgrounds.

items.name: Apple Minimalism
items.description: Product-on-white, single hero shot, one-line copy.
items.prompt_inject: Apply Apple-level minimalism: pure white background, single product hero shot with precise shadow, one-line benefit statement in thin sans-serif.

items.name: Flat Design 2.0
items.description: Clean vectors with subtle gradients and long shadows.
items.prompt_inject: Use Flat Design 2.0: clean vector illustrations, subtle gradients, long drop shadows, rounded corners, and a vibrant but limited color palette.

items.name: Viral Meme Engineering
items.description: Format designed for social sharing and remix.
items.prompt_inject: Engineer for virality: use a recognizable meme format, Impact font, relatable humor, and leave visual space for user remix and sharing.

items.name: Parallax Depth Storytelling
items.description: Multi-layer scrolling with foreground/background separation.
items.prompt_inject: Design for parallax depth: create distinct foreground, midground, and background layers that move at different speeds to create immersive 3D storytelling.

items.name: Skeuomorphic Realism
items.description: Digital elements mimicking real-world textures.
items.prompt_inject: Apply skeuomorphic design: make digital elements look tactile with leather textures, metal rivets, glass reflections, and realistic material properties.

items.name: Growth Hacking CTA Matrix
items.description: Data-driven conversion-optimized call-to-action design.
items.prompt_inject: Optimize for conversion: use contrasting CTA button colors, directional cues pointing to the action, social proof numbers, and urgency micro-copy.

items.name: Unboxing Experience Design
items.description: Product reveal choreography for maximum anticipation.
items.prompt_inject: Choreograph an unboxing sequence: build anticipation through packaging layers, reveal the product with dramatic lighting, and capture the 'wow' moment.

items.name: Instagram Aesthetic Grid
items.description: Cohesive visual feed design with consistent filters.
items.prompt_inject: Design for Instagram grid cohesion: use consistent color grading, alternating content types, and ensure each frame works alone AND as part of a 3x3 grid.

items.name: Google Material Design
items.description: Elevation, motion, and bold color with purpose.
items.prompt_inject: Apply Material Design principles: use elevation shadows for hierarchy, bold accent colors, meaningful motion, and responsive grid with 8dp baseline grid.

items.name: Storytelling Data Visualization
items.description: Complex data made beautiful and narrative-driven.
items.prompt_inject: Transform product data into visual narrative: use elegant infographics, animated charts, comparative timelines, and data-as-art to tell the product story.

items.name: TikTok Hook Framework
items.description: First-3-second scroll-stopping hook design.
items.prompt_inject: Design a TikTok hook: the first 3 seconds must contain a visual or textual pattern interrupt. Use text overlay, zoom-in, or impossible visual to stop the scroll.

items.name: ASMR Sensory Trigger
items.description: Close-up tactile/auditory sensory stimulation.
items.prompt_inject: Design for ASMR sensation: extreme macro close-ups of product textures, slow-motion interactions, and imply satisfying sounds through visual cues.

items.name: Dark Mode Premium UI
items.description: OLED-optimized dark interface with accent glows.
items.prompt_inject: Design for dark mode: use true black (#000) backgrounds, subtle gray elevation layers, neon accent glows, and high-contrast typography for premium feel.

items.name: Glassmorphism Layer
items.description: Frosted glass panels with background blur.
items.prompt_inject: Apply glassmorphism: use frosted semi-transparent panels with background blur, subtle borders, and layered depth to create a modern, airy UI aesthetic.

items.name: AI-Generated Surrealism
items.description: Dreamlike impossible scenes only AI can create.
items.prompt_inject: Generate AI surrealism: create physically impossible but visually stunning scenes — melting architecture, floating objects, impossible geometry — that showcase the product in a dreamscape.

items.name: Micro-Interaction Delight
items.description: Tiny animated responses to user actions.
items.prompt_inject: Design micro-interactions: every button press, hover, and scroll should trigger a delightful miniature animation — confetti, ripple, morph, or bounce.

items.name: Neomorphism Soft UI
items.description: Soft extruded elements with inner/outer shadows.
items.prompt_inject: Apply neomorphism: use soft, extruded UI elements with matching background colors, subtle inner and outer shadows creating a clay-like tactile interface.

items.name: Influencer POV Native Ad
items.description: First-person creator-style authentic content.
items.prompt_inject: Frame as influencer POV: use first-person camera angle, casual framing, natural lighting, text overlays in creator style, and authentic 'day-in-my-life' staging.

items.name: Dopamine Color Engineering
items.description: Neurologically optimized color combinations for engagement.
items.prompt_inject: Engineer dopamine colors: use high-saturation complementary pairs (electric purple + lime green, hot pink + cyan) calibrated to trigger maximum visual pleasure.

items.name: NFT Digital Collectible Frame
items.description: Product as exclusive digital artifact with rarity tiers.
items.prompt_inject: Present the product as a digital collectible: use holographic borders, rarity badges (Legendary/Epic/Rare), edition numbers, and blockchain-inspired visual elements.

items.name: Spatial Computing Ad
items.description: 3D product placement in mixed reality spaces.
items.prompt_inject: Design for spatial computing: place the product as a floating 3D hologram in a real environment with depth, parallax, and interactive gaze-point highlights.

items.name: Neural Sound Frequencies
items.description: BGM that triggers focus via specific frequencies.
items.prompt_inject: Instruct the audio engine to use 40Hz binaural beats in the background to enhance viewer focus and product recall.

items.name: Personalized DNA Ad
items.description: Hyper-personalized creative that adapts to viewer data.
items.prompt_inject: Design a template with 5 dynamic swap zones: hero image, headline, CTA color, testimonial, and price — each tagged for real-time personalization by viewer segment.

items.name: Digital Twin Showcase
items.description: Photorealistic interactive 3D product replica.
items.prompt_inject: Render the product as a photorealistic digital twin: show 360° rotation, exploded-view internals, material close-ups, and interactive hotspot annotations.

items.name: Emotion AI Reactive
items.description: Content that shifts based on detected viewer emotion.
items.prompt_inject: Design 3 emotional variants of the same ad: a 'happy' version (warm, bright), a 'curious' version (mysterious, teasing), and a 'stressed' version (calming, reassuring).

items.name: Haptic Feedback Visual
items.description: Visuals designed to imply tactile sensation.
items.prompt_inject: Design visuals that trigger phantom haptics: show extreme texture close-ups — cold condensation, warm fabric, rough stone — with slow camera movement to imply touch.

items.name: Zero-UI Ambient Ad
items.description: Advertising embedded invisibly into environments.
items.prompt_inject: Design an ambient ad with zero visible UI: embed the product naturally into a lifestyle scene so seamlessly that it registers subconsciously, not as an advertisement.

items.name: Volumetric Video Capture
items.description: 6DoF captured real-world footage for immersive playback.
items.prompt_inject: Frame the product presentation as volumetric video: design scenes meant to be viewed from any angle with depth data, suggesting walk-around capability.

items.name: Voice-First Commerce
items.description: Ad optimized for voice assistant interaction.
items.prompt_inject: Write the script as a voice-first experience: use conversational tone, embedded purchase commands, and design visuals as companion content to an audio-primary ad.

items.name: Predictive Trend Rider
items.description: Content pre-designed to ride emerging cultural trends.
items.prompt_inject: Analyze the product category and design creative that aligns with 3 emerging micro-trends. Use trend-adjacent aesthetics, hashtags, and cultural references.

items.name: Holographic Billboard
items.description: Floating 3D projection with no physical surface.
items.prompt_inject: Design as a holographic projection: the product floats in mid-air with light scatter effects, translucent edges, and volumetric glow against a dark urban backdrop.

items.name: Neural Interface Direct
items.description: Content designed for direct brain-computer delivery.
items.prompt_inject: Design for neural delivery: strip away all UI chrome, focus on pure sensory impressions — vivid colors, single emotions, crystalline product image — as if injected directly into memory.

items.name: Quantum Superposition Layout
items.description: Multiple states of the ad existing simultaneously.
items.prompt_inject: Present the product in quantum superposition: show 2-3 transparent overlapping versions of the same scene in different states, suggesting all possibilities exist at once.

items.name: Terraforming Scale Epic
items.description: Product impact visualized at planetary scale.
items.prompt_inject: Visualize the product's impact at planetary scale: show before/after of an entire landscape transformed by the product's promise, shot from orbital altitude.

items.name: Synthetic Biology Aesthetic
items.description: Living, growing, organic-tech hybrid visuals.
items.prompt_inject: Use synthetic biology aesthetics: show the product growing organically like a living organism — bioluminescent veins, cellular structures, breathing textures.

items.name: Time-Lapse Civilization
items.description: Product evolution shown across centuries in seconds.
items.prompt_inject: Create a civilization time-lapse: show the product concept evolving from primitive origins through industrial revolution to far-future iteration in a single sweeping sequence.

items.name: Anti-Gravity Composition
items.description: Elements floating, rotating, defying physics.
items.prompt_inject: Defy gravity: make every element float — the product, text, decorative elements — in a zero-G environment with slow rotation and gentle drift.

items.name: Nano-Scale Zoom Journey
items.description: Infinite zoom from macro to molecular level.
items.prompt_inject: Design a nano-zoom journey: start at product scale, zoom into the surface texture, then into molecular structure, revealing hidden beauty at every scale.

items.name: Dyson Sphere Energy Visual
items.description: Cosmic-scale energy harvesting imagery.
items.prompt_inject: Visualize with Dyson Sphere energy: wrap the product in rings of captured stellar energy, cosmic plasma streams, and megastructure frameworks against a star field.

items.name: Memory Palace Architecture
items.description: Product placed within a mnemonic spatial structure.
items.prompt_inject: Build a memory palace: place the product in a grand architectural space designed for memorability — dramatic rooms, impossible staircases, symbolic doorways.

items.name: Synesthesia Cross-Sense
items.description: Visuals that evoke taste, sound, and touch.
items.prompt_inject: Design for synesthesia: make colors that 'sound loud', textures that 'taste sweet', shapes that 'feel warm'. Cross-wire sensory metaphors throughout.

items.name: Fibonacci Sacred Geometry
items.description: Golden ratio and sacred geometric patterns.
items.prompt_inject: Apply sacred geometry: use Fibonacci spirals, golden ratio proportions, Flower of Life patterns, and Metatron's Cube as the underlying compositional framework.

items.name: Liminal Space Unsettling
items.description: Empty, transitional spaces creating unease and curiosity.
items.prompt_inject: Place the product in a liminal space: empty malls, endless corridors, poolrooms with no people — creating eerie familiarity that makes the product the only anchor point.

items.name: Wabi-Sabi Imperfection
items.description: Beauty in imperfection, transience, and incompleteness.
items.prompt_inject: Apply Wabi-Sabi philosophy: show the product with intentional imperfections — weathered edges, asymmetry, natural aging — celebrating beauty in the incomplete.

items.name: Mandala Meditation Focus
items.description: Concentric, radially symmetric hypnotic patterns.
items.prompt_inject: Design a product mandala: place the product at the center of a radially symmetric pattern with concentric rings of increasing detail, creating meditative focus.

items.name: Negative Space Reveal
items.description: Product or message hidden in the empty space.
items.prompt_inject: Use negative space mastery: hide the product silhouette or brand message in the empty space between visible elements, creating an 'aha' discovery moment.

items.name: Color Field Rothko
items.description: Large blocks of pure color evoking deep emotion.
items.prompt_inject: Apply Rothko's color field approach: use 2-3 large, softly bordered blocks of deeply saturated color to create an emotional atmosphere, with the product floating at the boundary.

items.name: Escher Impossible Object
items.description: Optically impossible constructions that fascinate.
items.prompt_inject: Create an Escher-inspired impossible object: the product exists in a physically impossible arrangement — Penrose triangles, infinite staircases, recursive loops.

items.name: Zen Minimalist Void
items.description: Maximum emptiness with single powerful element.
items.prompt_inject: Apply Zen void: 90% of the frame is empty space. The product sits alone in vast nothingness, creating gravity through absence. One element. One breath.

items.name: Fractal Infinite Detail
items.description: Self-similar patterns at every zoom level.
items.prompt_inject: Design with fractal recursion: the product's form repeats at every scale level — zoom in and the same pattern emerges infinitely, suggesting boundless depth.

items.name: Anchoring Price Illusion
items.description: Strategic price presentation to manipulate perceived value.
items.prompt_inject: Deploy price anchoring: show a dramatically inflated 'original' price crossed out next to the real price. Add a premium competitor comparison to make the deal irresistible.

items.name: Scarcity Countdown
items.description: Limited time/quantity urgency triggers.
items.prompt_inject: Trigger scarcity response: add countdown timers, 'Only 3 left' badges, 'limited edition' stamps, and real-time purchase notifications to create FOMO.

items.name: Social Proof Avalanche
items.description: Overwhelming evidence of popularity and trust.
items.prompt_inject: Stack social proof: include star ratings, review count (10,000+), celebrity endorsement, 'as seen on' media logos, and real-time 'X people viewing now' counters.

items.name: Loss Aversion Frame
items.description: Emphasize what viewer loses by NOT buying.
items.prompt_inject: Frame through loss aversion: show the painful 'without' scenario first in desaturated gray, then the 'with product' scenario in vivid color. Make NOT buying feel costly.

items.name: Authority Figure Endorsement
items.description: Expert, doctor, or scientist backing the product.
items.prompt_inject: Deploy authority bias: show the product endorsed by a lab-coat professional, framed by certificates, clinical data, and institutional typography that screams credibility.

items.name: Bandwagon Momentum
items.description: Everyone's doing it, don't get left behind.
items.prompt_inject: Create bandwagon momentum: show crowds using the product, trending hashtag counters climbing, world map with adoption dots spreading virally across continents.

items.name: Reciprocity Gift Hook
items.description: Give something free to create obligation to buy.
items.prompt_inject: Trigger reciprocity: lead with a genuine free gift, valuable tip, or exclusive content before the pitch. Design the freebie to look premium and desirable.

items.name: Zeigarnik Cliffhanger
items.description: Incomplete information that compels completion.
items.prompt_inject: Apply the Zeigarnik effect: reveal 70% of the product benefit but leave a tantalizing gap. Use 'Part 1 of 3' labels, blurred reveals, and 'swipe to discover' cues.

items.name: Mirror Neuron Trigger
items.description: Show someone experiencing the product to trigger empathy.
items.prompt_inject: Activate mirror neurons: show a person experiencing genuine joy/relief/satisfaction using the product in extreme close-up facial expressions that the viewer involuntarily mimics.

items.name: Cognitive Ease Fluency
items.description: Make everything effortlessly easy to process.
items.prompt_inject: Maximize cognitive fluency: use high-contrast text, simple words, rhyming taglines, symmetrical layouts, and familiar visual patterns. If it's easy to read, it feels true.

items.name: Cinematic One-Take Flow
items.description: Seamless single-shot narrative with no cuts.
items.prompt_inject: Design as a single continuous take: the camera never cuts. One fluid motion through environments, revealing the product story in an unbroken choreographed sequence.

items.name: Fourth Wall Break
items.description: Character directly addresses and acknowledges the viewer.
items.prompt_inject: Break the fourth wall: have the subject look directly into camera, acknowledge they're in an ad, and use meta-humor to create authentic connection with the viewer.

items.name: Epic Orchestral Build
items.description: Musical score that builds from whisper to thunderous climax.
items.prompt_inject: Score with epic orchestral build: start with a solo piano, layer strings, add percussion, build to a full orchestra crescendo at the product reveal. Design visuals to match the dynamic range.

items.name: Multi-Universe Split
items.description: Same product shown across parallel reality versions.
items.prompt_inject: Split into parallel universes: show the same product in 3-4 wildly different realities (medieval, cyberpunk, underwater, space) in split-screen, converging to one at the end.

items.name: Reverse Chronology
items.description: Story told backwards from result to origin.
items.prompt_inject: Tell the story in reverse: start with the triumphant result, then rewind scene by scene to the moment of purchase. Each rewind reveals a new layer of the product's impact.

items.name: Silence is Golden
items.description: Complete silence with only visuals speaking.
items.prompt_inject: Use total silence: no music, no voiceover, no sound effects. Let the visuals carry everything. Use title cards for text. The silence itself becomes the loudest statement.

items.name: Ultra-Low Latency Generation
items.description: Instant high-quality video completion.
items.prompt_inject: Optimize for speed. Minimize transition complexity to ensure the 60fps result feels instant yet cinematic.

items.name: Recursive Meta-Ad
items.description: An ad about making an ad about the product.
items.prompt_inject: Go meta-recursive: show the process of creating this very ad — the brainstorming, the AI prompts, the iterations — making the behind-the-scenes the content itself.

items.name: Emotional Time Capsule
items.description: Future-you thanks past-you for discovering this product.
items.prompt_inject: Create a time capsule: frame the ad as a message from the viewer's future self, thanking them for discovering this product today. Use aged film effects transitioning to crystal clarity.

items.name: The Banseok Singularity
items.description: All 99 techniques fused into one transcendent creative.
items.prompt_inject: ACTIVATE SINGULARITY MODE: Select the 5 most powerful techniques from the Arsenal that match this product's essence. Layer them simultaneously — visual style, psychological trigger, narrative structure, compositional framework, and emotional frequency — into a single unified masterpiece that transcends any individual technique.
